# FBM Studio

> FBM Studio is an AI-powered Go-To-Market platform for AI startup founders. It helps founders generate startup ideas, build GTM strategies, create marketing content, and launch with paying customers.

## Core Tools

- [AI Startup Idea Generator (Ideator)](https://fbm-studio.com/ideator): Free tool that generates validated AI startup ideas. Users pick a niche and market, and receive complete business concepts with target audience, API integrations, revenue model, and go-to-market strategy.
- [GTM Bootcamp](https://fbm-studio.com/gtm-bootcamp): A structured go-to-market program for AI founders. Includes ICP analysis, competitive positioning, marketing channel selection, ad creative generation, and a 90-day launch plan. Starts with a free 15-minute diagnostic call.

## What FBM Studio Does

FBM Studio solves the #1 problem AI founders face: building a great product but failing to find paying customers. The platform provides:

1. **Idea Validation** — AI-generated startup concepts with built-in market validation
2. **ICP Analysis** — Detailed Ideal Customer Profile with demographics, psychographics, and jobs-to-be-done
3. **GTM Strategy** — Personalized go-to-market plan with channel recommendations and positioning
4. **Ad Creatives** — AI-generated scripts, hooks, and visual concepts for Facebook/Meta ads
5. **Marketing Automation** — Frequency-based marketing (FBM) framework for consistent customer acquisition

## Target Audience

- AI startup founders looking to launch their first product
- Technical builders who need marketing guidance
- Solo founders building AI SaaS products
- Teams pivoting to AI-powered products
- Anyone exploring AI business ideas

## Key Topics

- Go-to-market strategy for AI startups
- AI startup idea generation and validation
- Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) for AI products
- Facebook/Meta ads for AI SaaS
- AI founder marketing playbook
- Frequency-based marketing methodology
